name: Team Charmander: Hyper-Offense & Pyrotechnic Dominance
archetype: Special Fire/Psychic starter sweeper, Ground physical breakers, and Intimidate aerial control.
gym_duel_rationale: Koga enforces a strict 4v4 duel. Lead with Charizard/Kadabra (457 BST Fire/Psychic with 112 SpA and 103 Spe; incinerates Beedrill/Scyther with STAB Flamethrower and destroys Venomoth/Grimer with STAB Psychic). Back with Primeape/Sandslash (457 BST breaker whose Vital Spirit ignores sleep while STAB Magnitude and Close Combat punish grounded Poison foes), Gyarados/Fearow (495 BST Water/Flying intimidator that neuters physical attackers upon entry while packing STAB Drill Peck and Ice Fang), and Dugtrio/Arbok (422 BST Ground/Poison trapper whose natural 100 BP Earthquake and priority Sucker Punch quickly remove Magnemite/Koffing and check Chansey/Muk).

roster.progression_notes: 457 BST with 112 SpA and 103 Speed. Obliterates Koga's Bug and Poison typings with STAB Flamethrower and Psychic while possessing instant Recover sustain.
457 BST physical fortress with 101 Attack and 93 Defense. Vital Spirit completely immunizes it against sleep powders while STAB Close Combat and Magnitude hit hard.
495 BST with 101 Attack and 93 Speed. Intimidate cripples enemy physical attackers upon entry, while Drill Peck deals super-effective damage to Bug/Poison foes.
422 BST with 96 Attack and 93 Speed. Arena Trap prevents escapes, while natural 100 BP Earthquake and priority Sucker Punch eliminate key targets.
425 BST with 100 SpA and Volt Absorb electric immunity. High speed Electric/Fire coverage sweeps through Water routes and trainers.

flex_bench.why_use: Retained for capturing rare Safari Zone targets with Compound Eyes boosted 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder.
Magic Guard completely prevents indirect damage, entry hazard chips, and Toxic poison ticks.

active_fusions: Charizard/Kadabra (457 BST Fire/Psychic with 112 SpA, 103 Spe, and Recover)
Primeape/Sandslash (457 BST Vital Spirit sleep-immune physical breaker)
Gyarados/Fearow (495 BST Water/Flying intimidator with Ice Fang and Drill Peck)
Dugtrio/Arbok (422 BST Ground/Poison trapper with Earthquake and Sucker Punch)
Jolteon/Houndour (425 BST Electric/Fire dual cannon with Volt Absorb)
unfuse_recommendations: 1. Maintain current party fusions; the lineup holds ideal Ground and Psychic coverage against Koga's Poison Gym.
2. When Linking Cords are obtained from Hotel Quests, unfuse Charizard/Kadabra ($300 at any Mart) to evolve Kadabra into Alakazam for maximum 135 SpA before re-fusing.
upcoming_fusions: Charizard/Alakazam (Endgame Fire/Psychic titan with Linking Cord)
